title: Houthis Claim Saudi Arabia Targeted Boat Carrying 14 Indians, Launch Rescue Operations
detail: Houthi authorities claimed Saudi forces targeted a boat carrying 14 Indian nationals and said they launched rescue operations. The claim comes from the Houthis and has not been independently verified; location and casualty details were not available.

media.caption: Houthis claim Saudi Arabia targeted boat carrying 14 Indians

title: Saudi Aramco Tells Staff to Evacuate Dhahran as Clashes With Houthis Continue
detail: Middle East Eye live blog reports Saudi Aramco told staff to evacuate Dhahran as clashes with Yemen's Houthis continue. Dhahran hosts Aramco headquarters, struck by a Houthi missile on Oct 13. Based on a single live-blog report; scope of the evacuation not independently confirmed.

media.caption: Saudi Aramco tells staff to evacuate Dhahran
